items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Dollar Brand had listened to it in South Africa and he said, 'Man, your record selling in South Africa. You got a hit record in South Africa.'

ctx.x: Yeah, and Dollar Brand had listened to it in South Africa and he said, 'Man, your record selling in South Africa. You got a hit record in South Africa.' I said, 'Well, I can't follow it up, you know, that.'
